subject: [hw] DONE V33 rev 3
body:
Rev 3: tests only, no shim behaviour change. 298 checks (was 292). New: the OAL-s own parser is run over the supplied virtual files with V30-s scanner -- per-line "processor : %d" and "CPU part : %x" must find 4x 0xd05 and 4x 0xd41 in /proc/cpuinfo, and "arm,cortex-a%d" on cpu7/of_node/compatible must give 78. This proves the vendor-s getProcessor()/topology path can parse what n2vfs returns, including the tab-vs-space format literal.

  bash gpu/hwcodec/shim/test_v33/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V33-TABLE PASS 27/27
    N2TEST V33 PASS 298/298   (ASan+UBSan -O1)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 298/298   (plain -O2)
    N2TEST V33 PASS 298/298   (TSan -O1)

Unchanged: all of DONE V33 rev 2 (the V30 F15 report stands; my heap-path test uses %s), and the integration datapoint: the full V30+V32+V33+V34 shim set links the five vendor objects with unresolved=0 (posted to hw-iv).
